063f2c226823f97a.description: Job description Job Description Overview AtkinsRéalis is seeking an experienced Senior Urban and Real Estate Economist to join its Advisory team in the Middle East. The role will provide economic, demographic and real estate market analysis to support development advisory, urban planning, master planning and infrastructure planning assignments. The successful candidate will translate population, household, employment and sector growth forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements, including: Land-use and development demand. Real estate asset mix and scale. Housing and employment requirements. Social infrastructure needs. Development capacity and absorption. Development and infrastructure phasing. Investment priorities. The candidate will work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside development advisors, urban planners, master planners, real estate specialists, infrastructure planners, engineers, transport specialists, GIS professionals and financial advisors. Your role Urban and Spatial Economics Undertake economic, demographic and socio-economic analysis for regional strategies, city plans, master plans and major development programmes. Prepare population, household, employment and economic forecasts at regional, city, district and development levels. Translate growth forecasts into spatial requirements for residential, commercial, retail, hospitality, industrial, mixed-use and community development. Assess relationships between economic activity, population distribution, employment, accessibility, land use and infrastructure provision. Develop and test alternative growth and development scenarios and assess their spatial implications. Prepare socio-economic baselines, city and regional benchmarks, economic impact assessments and wider-benefits analysis. Translate demographic forecasts into requirements for housing and social infrastructure, including education, healthcare, recreation and community facilities. Work with planning and GIS teams to spatially represent population, employment, economic activity and development demand. Real Estate Economics Undertake real estate market, demand and supply assessments across relevant asset classes. Analyse market drivers, existing and planned supply, occupancy, take-up, pricing, absorption and competing developments. Prepare development demand forecasts for residential, office, retail, hospitality, industrial and other real estate uses. Provide economic and market inputs into development positioning, land-use mix, scale, density and phasing. Assess the market supportability and absorption of proposed development programmes. Support highest-and-best-use studies, development strategies, land strategies and master plans. Test development scenarios against economic, demographic and real estate market conditions. Work with financial advisors to align market assumptions, development programmes and financial feasibility. Provide evidence to support development, land-use and investment decisions. Development and Infrastructure Planning Translate population, employment and real estate forecasts into high-level infrastructure and service-demand assumptions. Support infrastructure planners in understanding how development growth affects transport, utilities, municipal services and social infrastructure. Identify development dependencies and infrastructure triggers affecting land release, development sequencing and phasing. Support the alignment of real estate absorption, development delivery and infrastructure investment. Provide economic and demand inputs into infrastructure strategies, investment plans and business cases. Project Delivery Lead defined urban and real estate economics workstreams within multidisciplinary advisory assignments. Develop clear methodologies, analytical frameworks, forecast models and evidence bases. Gather and analyse quantitative and qualitative information from government, commercial and client sources. Prepare high-quality technical reports, presentations, working papers and executive summaries. Translate complex analysis into clear findings and practical recommendations for planning, development and investment decisions. Present analysis and recommendations to clients and project stakeholders. Business and Practice Development Contribute to technical and commercial proposals across development advisory, urban planning, real estate and infrastructure planning. Support client engagement and the identification of new business opportunities. Develop reusable datasets, forecasting tools, analytical methodologies and templates. Contribute to market insights and thought leadership on urban growth, real estate development and regional economic trends. Share knowledge and good practice across Advisory and the wider AtkinsRéalis business. Support the professional development of junior economists and analysts. Champion collaboration, inclusion and high-quality delivery. About you Education Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Real Estate Economics, Urban Economics, Economic Geography, Regional Science, Urban Planning or a related discipline. Master’s degree in Urban Economics, Real Estate, Economics, Development Economics, Economic Geography, Urban Planning or a related field is preferred. Professional Experience / Qualifications Typically +8 years of relevant experience; Experience in urban economics, real estate economics, development advisory, socio-economics or a related consulting discipline. Demonstrable ability to translate economic and demographic forecasts into spatial and real estate requirements. Experience supporting master plans, development strategies, regional plans, regeneration programmes or major real estate developments. Experience in real estate market assessment and demand forecasting across one or more asset classes. Good understanding of the relationship between economic growth, population, employment, land use, real estate markets and infrastructure. Strong quantitative, forecasting and analytical capability. Advanced capability in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Experience with GIS, statistical analysis or data-visualisation tools is desirable. Experience in the UAE, KSA or wider GCC is strongly preferred. Experience within a consultancy, development authority, planning agency, real estate advisor or government organisation is advantageous. Behavioral Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to move from data and evidence to practical recommendations. Ability to connect economic and real estate analysis with physical planning, development and investment decisions. Excellent written communication, report-writing and presentation skills. Ability to communicate complex analysis clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong attention to detail and commitment to analytical quality. Commercial awareness and understanding of the factors influencing real estate and development decisions. Ability to manage defined workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs within agreed programmes and budgets. Confidence working within multidisciplinary and multicultural teams. Ability to operate effectively where information or project requirements may be evolving. Proactive, collaborative and willing to take responsibility for assigned deliverables. Ability to prioritise competing tasks and work effectively under pressure. Fluency in written and spoken English; Arabic language capability is advantageous. Willingness to travel within the UAE, KSA and wider GCC. Commitment to delivering sustainable, inclusive and commercially viable development outcomes. Rewards & benefits Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. This includes: Tax-free salary. Life insurance coverage. Medical insurance. Annual leave balance. Company gratuity scheme. Discretionary bonus program. Annual flight contribution. Transportation & housing allowances. 06a1f463b01351c9.description: About the Role FNRCO is seeking a Lead Security Engineer to manage the performance, reliability, integration, and maintenance of electronic security systems within an airport environment. Ensure seamless integration between CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, intercom, and airport command centre systems. Ability to coordinate effectively with government and airport security authorities. Proficiency in both Arabic and English for technical reporting and communication.

The operator will coordinate with relevant parties to maintain the continuity and quality control of water supplies. Key Responsibilities Ensure all work adheres to approved policies, processes, procedures, and instructions. Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in systems and practices, focusing on cost reduction, productivity, and efficiency. Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, bylaws, and standards within the Water Transmission Company, including those related to Human Capital, Safety, Industrial Security, Risk, and Cyber Security. Escalate issues to ensure timely and efficient resolution of challenges. Conduct operational monitoring of pumping stations and pipelines, ensuring adherence to standard operating procedures and addressing any deficiencies or malfunctions. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports on incidents, pumping efficiency, resource consumption, and equipment performance, discussing findings with relevant parties for process improvement. Perform periodic inspections of equipment and systems to ensure operational efficiency and coordinate with maintenance teams for scheduled preventive and corrective maintenance. Implement operational and safety procedures for electrical and mechanical equipment, ensuring personnel comply with occupational safety requirements. Coordinate pumping and distribution operations through continuous communication with the Central Control Room (CCR) and Local Control Stations (LCR) to ensure efficient water flow. Issue work permits and supervise maintenance work by internal teams and contractors, ensuring compliance with work procedures, safety, and quality. Analyze operational performance by monitoring consumption, comparing forecasts with actual production, and suggesting improvements to efficiency and breakdown reduction. Perform isolation and re-energization of mechanical and electrical equipment (medium and low voltage) following safety procedures. Monitor water quality in coordination with laboratory teams, ensuring compliance with quality standards and addressing any defects affecting water quality. Participate in planning and developing operational systems by proposing design improvements, developing standard operating procedures, and ensuring compliance with technical standards. Develop and implement emergency plans and procedures for operational disruptions and crises, ensuring rapid response and minimizing damage. Operate the Central Control Room manually or electronically according to the shift schedule, ensuring continuous monitoring of pumping load and tank levels. Inspect and monitor Central Control Room operations by reading gauges, graphs, online analysis devices, computer screens, and other systems for early problem detection. Qualifications and Experience Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or a relevant field. 5-10 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the Water Transmission Company, based in Saudi Arabia, focusing on critical infrastructure operations. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply.

06eb4f0f87ec5e9e.description: The Manager – Government Relations is responsible for managing all regulatory, permitting, and licensing activities required across URED&s development and property portfolio. The role ensures timely and compliant engagement with all relevant Saudi government authorities, safeguarding project delivery timelines and URED& operational licences. The GR Manager builds and maintains productive relationships with key regulatory bodies including Municipality (Baladiya), Civil Defence, MOMRA, SEC, NWC, and other relevant authorities, ensuring all approvals, connections, and certifications are secured within target timeframes. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Regulatory Permits, Licences &Approvals ▪ Manage the end-to-end process for all regulatory certificates, permits, and licences across URED projects within target timelines. ▪ Obtain building permits, Civil Defence certificates, completion certificates, and occupancy approvals. ▪ Manage issuance of required governmental approvals, certifications, and registrations for all URED departments. ▪ Monitor and track all permit and approval statuses through a structured tracker (Excel/Wrike). Public Utility Connections ▪ Manage electricity connections with SEC (Saudi Electricity Company) within target timelines. ▪ Coordinate water and sewage connections with NWC (National Water Company). ▪ Ensure all public utility activations are completed prior to project handover. Government Relations & Authority Management ▪ Build and maintain productive relationships with Baladiya, Civil Defence, MOMRA, SEC, NWC, and other regulatory bodies. ▪ Liaise with ministries and government entities to resolve project-specific regulatory issues. ▪ Represent URED professionally in all government interactions. ▪ Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting UREDs development activities and communicate updates to management. Policies, Procedures & Governance ▪ Develop and maintain GR department policies and procedures in line with Saudi law and URED objectives. ▪ Ensure all GR processes are documented, consistent, and auditable. ▪ Manage formal correspondence and official letters with government entities. ▪ Ensure all GR documentation is properly filed and maintained within URED systems. Team Leadership ▪ Direct, manage, and develop the GR Coordinator. ▪ Allocate tasks and responsibilities within the GR team. ▪ Ensure the Coordinator understands their KPIs and accountability frameworks. FRAMEWORKS, BOUNDARIES & DECISION-MAKING AUTHORITY ▪ Reports directly to the CTSO. ▪ Financial authority as per URED Delegation of Authority (DoA). ▪ Authority to engage and negotiate directly with government authorities on URED& behalf. ▪ Authority to approve GR-related correspondence and formal letters. ▪ No authority to commit URED to any financial, legal, or contractual obligations without CTSO approval. ▪ Authority to sign off on permit applications and regulatory documentation via DocuSign. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) Building permits obtained within 4–6 weeks of application. ▪ Civil Defence certificate secured within 2–4 weeks of project completion. ▪ Completion certificates obtained within 4–6 weeks of practical completion. ▪ SEC electricity activation completed within 6–8 weeks of connection application. ▪ Water and sewage connections completed within 6–8 weeks of NWC application. ▪ 100% of regulatory submissions made within required timelines. ▪ Zero regulatory or authority-related project delays attributable to GR function. ▪ Zero fines or penalties for regulatory non-compliance. INTERNAL& EXTERNAL COMMUNICATIONS Internal ▪ CTSO — Permit status reporting, escalation of regulatory issues, strategic alignment. ▪ Construction Team — Permit and approval coordination for project delivery. ▪ Design & Engineering — Regulatory submission support for planning and design approvals. ▪ UAPM Operations — Operational licence and connection coordination. ▪ Finance — Government fee processing and budget tracking. External ▪ Baladiya (Municipality) — Building permits, completion certificates, occupancy approvals. ▪ Civil Defence — Fire safety certificates and inspections. ▪ MOMRA — Regulatory compliance and planning approvals. ▪ SEC (Saudi Electricity Company) — Power connection applications and activations. ▪ NWC (National Water Company) — Water and sewage connections. ▪ Other relevant ministries and regulatory bodies as applicable. Qualifications ▪ Bachelor&Degree in Business Administration, Law, Engineering, or related field (preferred). ▪ Diploma with extensive relevant experience will be considered. Experience Minimum 6–8 years of experience in Government Relations, regulatory affairs, or permit management in Saudi Arabia. ▪ Proven experience managing permits and approvals for real estate development projects. ▪ Strong established relationships with Baladiya, Civil Defence, SEC, and NWC. Technical Skills & Tools ▪ Strong knowledge of Saudi regulatory environment: SBC, MOMRA, Civil Defence, SEC, and NWC processes. ▪ Permit tracking via Excel or Wrike. ▪ Microsoft 365 — Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Word. ▪ DocuSign — Digital sign-off on permit applications and regulatory submissions. ▪ Arabic (must — primary language for authority communication). ▪ English (required for internal reporting and documentation). ▪ Claude (Anthropic) — working familiarity with Claude as an AI productivity tool for drafting, working on MS applications, integration with department applications, research, data summarisation, presentation, and content generation within the function. Behavioral Competencies ▪ Excellent relationship management and interpersonal skills. ▪ Negotiation and influence with government officials. ▪ High integrity and professional conduct. ▪ Organized, systematic, and deadline-driven. ▪ Proactive and solution-oriented. ▪ Clear communication — bilingual (Arabic and English). Functional Competencies ▪ Saudi regulatory and authority environment expertise. ▪ Permit and approval process management. ▪ Formal correspondence and documentation management. ▪ Government stakeholder relationship management. ▪ Team leadership and coordination.

The Front Desk Administrator manages reception operations, sales follow-up, appointment scheduling, and retail support, ensuring adherence to company standards and local regulations. Key Responsibilities Greet, register, and guide clients with professionalism, ensuring a welcoming experience. Maintain clear communication in English and/or Arabic, responding promptly to phone, WhatsApp, and email inquiries. Manage appointment bookings, confirmations, and reminders to optimize show-up rates. Handle client complaints empathetically and resolve issues efficiently to maintain client loyalty. The company has been recognized as a Great Place to Work® and employs over 400 individuals. Unifonic serves more than 5000 customer-centric companies, operating within a collaborative work environment that encourages new ideas. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, involves leading collaboration with virtual teams comprising sales, engineering, and support resources. The consultant will build and maintain strong customer relationships, influence strategic direction, and serve as a trusted advisor to CXOs and technology decision-makers. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Act as a technical liaison between Sales and Product teams during the sales process, supporting solution design, quotes, proposals, RFP responses, and related documentation. Develop working knowledge of Unifonic's conversational AI and omnichannel communications platform. Participate in Sales team meetings to understand customer pain points, requirements, and business goals, and help shape relevant solutions. Support problem escalation and best-practice efforts to assist clients and internal teams in using Unifonic's products effectively. Build and deliver product demonstrations and pilots that showcase Unifonic's value to prospects and clients. Relay timely, organized client feedback to Product Management, Sales, Support, and Development based on business cases. Ensure clean handoffs of won deals to the Customer Success team, providing clear context on customer goals and configuration. Support Sales and Account Management on upsell and cross-sell opportunities with technical input. Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Engineering, as needed to close deals. Customer Engagement The consultant will assist customers in evaluating their cloud communication strategy, recommend solutions aligned with business and technical requirements, remove deployment roadblocks, and ensure successful adoption to drive customer satisfaction. This includes driving executive-level engagement with CXOs and technology decision-makers. Sales Team Contribution The Sales team at Unifonic focuses on driving revenue while serving as trusted consultants. This role contributes to a team of experts in account management, business development, and customer service, working cross-departmentally to ensure products and services meet customer needs. Application Information Candidates with a track record of success in sales, an ability to build relationships, and a passion for helping others are encouraged to apply. 06addbfba40c9036.description: About the Role Siemens Energy is seeking a Senior Welder to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role involves executing specialized welding activities on critical power generation equipment, including weld build-ups and repairs, while adhering to safety, efficiency, and quality standards under the guidance of Field Service leadership. The Senior Welder will apply advanced welding expertise and problem-solving skills to address complex technical challenges, supporting the reliable operation and maintenance of plant assets during outage and service activities. Responsibilities Execute maintenance, repair, modification, and welding activities on large steam and gas turbine generators at customer power plants across KSA and international locations. Work as part of and lead mechanical maintenance crews in the disassembly, inspection, repair, and reassembly of turbine generators and associated equipment. Plan and execute site activities in compliance with Siemens Energy Quality, EHS standards, project documentation, and safety procedures. Conduct site surveys, review technical drawings and task plans, develop maintenance strategies, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to teams and subcontractors. Champion a strong safety culture by leading safety programs, conducting risk assessments, enforcing PPE requirements, and ensuring a safe working environment during outage and maintenance activities. Qualifications and Requirements A minimum of 10 years of experience in welding and related field service activities. Demonstrated advanced welding expertise and critical problem-solving skills. Ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical challenges in power generation equipment. Experience in leading mechanical maintenance crews. Commitment to safety standards and procedures. About Siemens Energy Siemens Energy is an energy technology company with approximately 100,000 employees in over 90 countries. The company develops energy systems to meet global energy demand reliably and sustainably. Its technologies contribute to the energy transition and generate a significant portion of the world's electricity. Siemens Energy is committed to sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy, building on a 150-year legacy of innovation with a focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Our Commitment to Diversity Siemens Energy values diversity, drawing strength from over 130 nationalities. The company promotes an inclusive environment and celebrates individual character, without discrimination based on ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. Siemens Energy aims to energize all of society.

06f9b9436f8f0cbe.description: نبذة عن الدور تتوفر فرصة عمل بدوام كامل لمواطن سعودي لشغل وظيفة بائع مجوهرات في مدينة الرياض. يبحث صاحب العمل عن مرشح جاد وملتزم للانضمام إلى فريق العمل، مع التركيز على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب احترافي وحسن، وتقديم المساعدة اللازمة لهم. عرض المنتجات وشرح تفاصيلها ومميزاتها للعملاء. المحافظة على ترتيب ونظافة منطقة العرض والمحل بشكل عام. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات العمل المحددة من قبل الإدارة. المؤهلات والمتطلبات أن يكون المتقدم مواطنًا سعوديًا. الجدية والالتزام في العمل. امتلاك مهارات تواصل جيدة وحسن التعامل مع الآخرين. لا يشترط وجود خبرة سابقة، حيث أن الدور مناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة. تفاصيل العمل نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الدوام: فترة واحدة يوميًا. الإجازة: يوم واحد أسبوعيًا. الموقع: الرياض. الراتب يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. التقديم ندعو المرشحين المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في محل المجوهرات بالرياض.

06c600f44379bd53.description: About BAE Systems Saudi Arabia BAE Systems is the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor under Government-to-Government arrangements, providing equipment, support, and training to Saudi Arabia. The company is responsible for the maintenance of Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF) aircraft and for training RSAF and Royal Saudi Naval Force personnel in the safe use of aircraft, equipment, and weapons. BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is committed to supporting the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudisation and the development of Saudi National capabilities through partnerships and industrialisation. The Role of Fleet Planner BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is seeking a Fleet Planner to join the Fleet Management section of the Typhoon Support Centre (TSC) in Taif, KSA. This full-time role involves performing fleet management and planning to ensure the RSAF Typhoon fleet is effectively managed and maintained in accordance with RSAF fleet plans and mandatory continuing airworthiness requirements. The Fleet Planner will report to the Fleet Plans and Statement of Requirement (SoR) Team Leader and should have 2-5 years of relevant experience. A competitive salary is offered for this position. Key Responsibilities Support the creation of tactical and strategic fleet management plans for endorsement by the TSC Commander (TSC Cdr), considering scheduled maintenance, modifications, and capability upgrades. Monitor Flying Hour (FH) and Fatigue Index (FI) consumption across the Typhoon fleet, compiling reports and recommendations for TSC Cdr’s approval to support fleet planning and ensure effective distribution of airframe life consumption. Create Typhoon maintenance activity programmes through ESS updates in conjunction with Forward Operations and TSC Business Data to assess impact on fleet availability and recommend appropriate planning strategies. Review Technical Instruction (TI) requirements with TSC Business Data personnel, Forward Operations, and Supply to assess fleet impact and recommend effective embodiment strategies for endorsement by the TSC Cdr. Monitor maintenance scheduling effectiveness and compliance of the Typhoon fleet against approved maintenance programme requirements. Coordinate reviews of reports and recommendations issued by the TSC In Service Data Analysis (ISDA) team in conjunction with TSC Technical Specialists and Forward Operations personnel to determine appropriate actions or initiate further investigation. Initiate ad-hoc analysis of Typhoon sub-system data by the TSC ISDA team and relevant Technical Specialists to identify trends and opportunities for development and improvements. Direct ad-hoc analysis of specific system in-service data by TSC ISDA and Technical Specialists to perform fleet management tasks. Develop and maintain TSC Processes and Procedures related to fleet management and planning. Generate and maintain status reports relevant to fleet management. Undertake additional tasks as requested by TSC and RSAF management. Assist with providing structured On-the-Job training for RSAF and/or Saudi National fleet management staff through training, coaching, work experience, and mentoring. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Environment and Location This full-time position is based at the Typhoon Support Centre (TSC) in Taif, KSA, within the Fleet Management section. The role involves working closely with various teams, including Forward Operations, TSC Business Data, TSC In Service Data Analysis (ISDA), and TSC Technical Specialists. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this Fleet Planner position at BAE Systems Saudi Arabia.

06deb515164996cf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجال للمختبرات عن فني كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية المتعلقة بتحليل العينات، مع الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة المهنية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال وتجهيز وتحضير العينات لإجراء الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية. تنفيذ الاختبارات والتحاليل الكيميائية والمخبرية وفق الطرق والإجراءات المعتمدة. تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية والتأكد من جاهزيتها للاستخدام اليومي. تحضير المحاليل والكواشف والمواد اللازمة لإجراء الاختبارات بدقة. تسجيل وإدخال نتائج التحاليل في الأنظمة المعتمدة ومراجعة دقتها. تطبيق إجراءات ضبط ومراقبة الجودة على عمليات الفحص والتحليل. المحافظة على العينات وسلامة تخزينها والتعامل معها وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب المختبر والأجهزة والمعدات بشكل مستمر. الإبلاغ عن الأعطال والملاحظات الفنية المتعلقة بالأجهزة أو العينات. الالتزام بتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية عند التعامل مع المواد الكيميائية والعينات. توثيق الأعمال والنتائج وإعداد التقارير المخبرية حسب متطلبات العمل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات المختبر والمعايير المعتمدة في الجودة والسلامة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال فني كيميائي أو مختبرات ذات صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ الاختبارات الكيميائية والمخبرية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بتشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية. المهارات والكفاءات الالتزام بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية. التعامل الآمن مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية. مهارات تسجيل وتوثيق النتائج بدقة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الكيمياء في مختبرات شركة اجال للمختبرات بمدينة تبوك، ضمن بيئة عمل تتطلب الالتزام الصارم بإجراءات السلامة والجودة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في تبوك.

06cd935ec0c8c673.description: About the Role Rosewood Hotel Group is seeking a Director of Talent Development to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading the strategic direction of learning and development across the resort, fostering a culture of continuous learning, leadership growth, operational excellence, and service mastery. The Director will be instrumental in strengthening organizational capability, elevating service standards, and supporting long-term talent success through impactful development initiatives, performance frameworks, and succession planning. This position plays a key leadership role in shaping the resort’s learning, development, and performance culture. The role involves close collaboration with operational leaders, department heads, and corporate partners to ensure associates are equipped to deliver luxury hospitality experiences aligned with Rosewood values and service standards. Key Responsibilities Develop and deliver a comprehensive talent development strategy aligned with Rosewood brand standards and operational objectives. Lead the implementation and sustainability of Forbes Five-Star service standards training across all departments, ensuring measurable and consistent execution. Design and drive learning initiatives including onboarding, brand immersion, leadership development, compliance training, and technical skills programs. Partner with operational leaders to embed service excellence behaviors into daily practices, service rituals, and performance expectations. Champion performance management, coaching, and development planning to support individual growth and organizational success. Monitor and evaluate learning effectiveness through key performance indicators, service assessments, guest feedback, and engagement metrics. Drive succession planning and talent review processes while promoting a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and excellence. Lead, mentor, and develop the Talent Development team, while overseeing learning resources, budgets, systems, and development facilities. Qualifications and Requirements Over 10 years of substantial experience in talent development, learning and development, or talent and culture leadership within luxury hospitality. Proven expertise in implementing and sustaining Forbes Five-Star service standards and luxury service excellence programs. Strong track record of leading learning functions and influencing leaders across complex hospitality operations. Highly skilled in leadership development, performance coaching, facilitation, and stakeholder partnership. Experience designing and implementing large-scale learning initiatives, capability frameworks, and talent development strategies. Ability to analyze development needs, measure program effectiveness, and translate insights into action. Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to inspire and engage diverse audiences. A degree in Human Resources, Hospitality, Business Administration, Education, or a related field. Professional training or coaching certifications are considered advantageous. Benefits Rosewood Hotel Group offers a benefits package that includes medical coverage, complimentary room nights, learning and development opportunities, and global career opportunities. Associates are also entitled to benefits and leave provisions in accordance with applicable Saudi Arabian labor laws and company policies.
